entries.note: Tutorial A4 says routes/allocations.js takes the user id from the URL. Verified at app/routes/allocations.js lines 16-23. The session-id alternative in that file is commented out.
Tutorial A7 says the benefits routes in routes/index.js check login only. Verified at app/routes/index.js lines 55-56. The isAdmin wiring is commented out beneath them.
The A4 tutorial's safe pattern is to read the user id from the session. displayContributions already does that at app/routes/contributions.js lines 13-17.
Tutorial A7 describes an isAdmin middleware. The live function at app/routes/session.js lines 25-28 loads the session user and checks isAdmin. The benefits routes do not call it.
Tutorial A1 documents eval of contribution amounts in routes/contributions.js. Verified at lines 32-34. The parseInt alternative in the same function is commented out.
Tutorial A1 documents NoSQL injection on the allocations threshold through MongoDB $where. Verified at app/data/allocations-dao.js lines 77-79, where the threshold is interpolated into $where.
When no threshold is supplied, the same function queries by the parsed user id only (lines 81-83) and does not build $where. That is the safe look-alike next to the documented NoSQL sink.

Tutorial A5 refers to the session secret as config.cookieSecret. The live literal is config/env/all.js line 8, and server.js passes it to express-session. It is a training string, not a live credential.
Tutorial A6 shows the demo crypto key literal. The same literal is the live config/env/all.js line 9. It is a training string, not a live credential.
Tutorial A6 says profile data such as the SSN is stored in the clear. Verified at app/data/profile-dao.js lines 61-63. The encrypt helper in that file is commented out.
addUser hashes the password with bcrypt before insert (lines 28-29). That is the safe look-alike beside the plaintext profile fields.

The SSRF tutorial says routes/research.js concatenates a caller-supplied URL and fetches it with needle. Verified at app/routes/research.js lines 14-16. No hostname allowlist is present in that function.
